reviewRequired.instruction: Inspect the actual PNG against every requested acceptance criterion. Identify invented claims, omitted actions, misleading data and missing required states.
Inspect hierarchy, readable labels, spacing, content density, imagery coherence and requested visual constraints. Record visible limitations instead of claiming untested behavior.
Check compatibility with bound brand or grammar references. Identify controls, live data and interactions that must remain native in implementation.
Retain the exact submitted prompt and actual image-generation result. File hashes prove retained bytes, not which model produced them.

Inspect the selected baseline beside the result. Preserve the declared shell, navigation, typography, palette and unchanged regions. Check only the requested changes were introduced. Use the relevant selected or current baseline, not merely the last generated image. A reference attachment or matching hash does not prove visual continuity.
